note: Set A binds nearly all values correctly to their tags and rows (e.g., F2 faucet model BSP-L-65014LF-PC, MWD02/MWD01/MWL01 millwork dimensions, CW and EX/RF locations), with only truncated values ("TIERRA S", "PORCELA") as blemishes. Set B covers a good range and gets many items right (TV size, P1/P2/P3 paint data, revision 4 date, cooktop model/manufacturer), but it misreads the F2 faucet model as "SP-L-65014LF-PC", binds the quartz thickness 1-3/16" to PT1 tile, invents a WB material of accent paint (wall base is MDF with finish as noted on elevations), and truncates the sink manufacturer to "FR". Those misbound and invented claims make B less faithful than A, whose errors are limited to clipped value strings.
